purpose: A primary dial for one timezone with secondary dials for others. The primary is the answer; the rest are context and must read as smaller.

night.recipe: The primary dial is --face-bg with --face-ink hands; the secondary dials sit on --face-plate with --face-ink-muted hands, so the stated hierarchy survives the flip. Ticks are --face-tick at two opacities.

options.intent: Highlights the primary dial only; the secondary dials stay unaccented so the eye lands on one.
An IANA name for the dial the owner reads first; local follows the device clock.
cast applies to the primary hands only; the secondary dials stay flat, which is another way the hierarchy is stated.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not construct an Intl.DateTimeFormat per render
antiPatterns.why: one formatter per zone, built once; construction costs milliseconds on a Pi and this used to run five times a second
